user.title: Connect your ViewMarq
user.description: Read the real display's identity and register settings. Setup starts the information rotation once connected.

error.cannot_connect: Could not identify the display. Check its address, port, unit ID, and network connection.

content.title: Rotating information
content.description: Choose your clock, date and weather. Each message appears as a stationary page. Longer messages use additional pages.

add_alert.title: Advanced custom rule
add_alert.description: Use raw HA states: a door binary sensor normally reports on when open; a cover reports open. Messages support {name} and {state}. Unknown/unavailable entities do not trigger alerts. For advanced conditions, select a template helper entity.

binary_alerts.title: Choose alert sensors
binary_alerts.description: Just select the sensors you want to watch. Messages use their names and meanings automatically. Doors and routine updates appear on the bottom row while normal information continues above. Smoke, gas, carbon monoxide, unsafe and wet sensors use the whole display. Unknown or unavailable sensors never create an alert. Remove a selection to stop watching it.

sensor_override.title: Customize one alert
sensor_override.description: Optional: choose a watched sensor to change its wording or where it appears.

sensor_details.title: Alert appearance
sensor_details.description: Automatic uses the sensor type. Leave the message blank to use its name and state automatically. Full-page alerts interrupt normal pages until cleared.

sports.title: Sports teams
sports.description: Scores come directly from ESPN. Only games in progress appear; no-game, unavailable and stale results are hidden. Use Add another sports team for more leagues and teams.

data.sports_max_age: Hide scores after this many minutes without an update

error.too_long: Keep the message list under 10,000 characters.
error.invalid_rule: Use a finite numeric threshold for above/below and a message of 1 to 190 characters.
error.sports_unavailable: ESPN is unavailable right now. Your existing teams are unchanged. Try again later.

abort.no_alerts: No alerts have been added yet.
